source: https://laoevisa.gov.la/application, https://laoevisa.gov.la/faq and https://laoevisa.gov.la/term/, read 2026-08-30. The live application exposes required labels, DD-MM-YYYY date prompts and JPG/JPEG/PNG uploads capped at 2 MB; the FAQ and terms publish the photo, passport, validity, visa-type and port rules. The portal publishes no text-field regexes, character limits or official validation error strings, so no pattern key is used and no local validator is mounted.

eligibility.label: eVisa nationality eligibility
eligibility.help: The portal publishes the passports eligible for eVisa. Check the exact passport before starting; visa exemption and visa on arrival are separate routes.

face_photo.label: Face photo
face_photo.help: The FAQ requires a 4 x 6 cm colour photo taken within the last 6 months, with no shadows, a plain white background, neutral expression and both eyes open. The upload accepts JPG, JPEG or PNG up to 2 MB.

passport_scan.label: Passport bio-page image
passport_scan.placeholder: Whole bio page including both MRZ lines
passport_scan.help: Upload the whole passport bio page including the two MRZ lines. The live application accepts JPG, JPEG or PNG up to 2 MB.

errors.required: A passport bio-page image is required

surname.label: Surname
surname.help: The live form says to type the surname as it appears in the passport.

given_names.label: Given names
given_names.help: The live form says to type all given names as they appear in the passport.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: The official application displays DD-MM-YYYY. Use its date control; this guide does not translate that prompt into an invented regex.

passport_number.label: Passport number
passport_number.placeholder: Use the passport you will carry
passport_number.help: The Approval Letter is tied to the passport in the application. Present that same passport at the border.

passport_validity.label: Passport validity and blank page
passport_validity.help: Only an ordinary passport qualifies. It must have more than 6 months of validity from arrival and at least one blank page for the entry permission sticker.

errors.required: Confirm passport validity and a blank page

port_of_entry.label: Designated port of entry
port_of_entry.placeholder: Choose one of the 9 eVisa ports
port_of_entry.help: The eVisa works only at the designated ports. The FAQ says the fee is not refunded if you arrive elsewhere.

errors.required: A designated port of entry is required

intended_entry_date.label: Intended entry date
intended_entry_date.help: The official form displays DD-MM-YYYY. The FAQ says the date may be no more than 60 days out and the system requires at least 5 days before arrival.

address_in_laos.label: Address during the visit
address_in_laos.help: Enter the address where you will stay in Laos. It is a required field in the travel-details section.

errors.required: Address during the visit is required
